card.name: Sadly and decline words in history text
card.fires_on: The adverb "sadly" used as a regretful aside in narrative or history prose, and the start of words like "dwind(ling)" and "barbar(ism/ous)".

modes.label: Sadly as aside
modes.description: The adverb "sadly" inserted to express regret about a loss or neglect.
modes.example: Traditional observance of Memorial Day has<< sadly>> diminished over the years.

modes.label: Start of dwindling
modes.description: The first part of "dwindling" before its ending, describing shrinking things.
modes.example: it helped to protect the then<< dwind>>ling forests.

modes.label: Start of barbarian words
modes.description: The first part of "barbarism", "barbarous" or "Barbaricum" in history writing.
modes.example: thereby reviving the Greek and Roman sense for imagistic art lost during the days of<< barbar>>ism.
